Terms of use

Last updated November 27, 2026.

ShelterDayOut is a free program of Charity Good (charitygood.org), a Colorado nonprofit corporation and 501(c)(3) public charity ("Charity Good", "we", "us"). By using ShelterDayOut (the "site") you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

A free directory, not a service provider

ShelterDayOut is an information directory. We list programs run by independent animal shelters and rescues. We don't run outings, sleepovers, visits or adoptions. Each shelter decides who may take part and sets its own rules, fees, agreements and waivers, which govern your outing. Listing a shelter doesn't mean the shelter endorses us or that we endorse it, and we're not affiliated with any listed organization unless its listing says so.

Where the information comes from

Listings are factual information (names, cities, websites, public phone numbers and emails, program descriptions and event dates) taken from each shelter's own public website or from government sources, written as short factual summaries. Some locations come from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License) and distances use GeoNames city data (CC BY 4.0). We check listings regularly, but details change and may be wrong or out of date. Always confirm with the shelter.

Outing requests

You can send a shelter an outing request through the site. We email your request to the shelter's public contact address and, where it has one, its program address, and keep a copy. Sending a request doesn't guarantee an outing. The shelter alone decides whether to approve it, and we aren't a party to any arrangement between you and a shelter. Requests require you to be 18 or older.

Animals and safety

Animals can be unpredictable. You're responsible for following the shelter's instructions and for your own conduct and safety, and that of anyone with you, during any outing or visit.

Names and trademarks

Shelter names, logos and trademarks belong to their owners and are used only to identify each organization. Corrections and removal requests are welcome through the For shelters page or by email.

Acceptable use

Don't submit false information, impersonate a shelter or another person, spam shelters through our forms, try to disrupt or break into the site, or copy the site's content in bulk by automated means.

Links to other sites

We link to shelters' and other organizations' websites for your convenience. We don't control those sites and aren't responsible for their content, policies or practices.

The site is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including accuracy, completeness, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

You agree to hold Charity Good harmless from claims arising from your misuse of the site or your breach of these terms.
